channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Dani Lima: Campanha de Flávio minimiza afunilamento da diferença com Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign downplays Lula's (PT) electoral growth and maintains a confident discourse in the final stretch. Journalist Daniela Lima notes the strategy avoids highlighting the PT candidate's gains.

item.title: O que explica a volta de ‘O Conto da Aia’ à lista dos livros mais vendidos de VEJA
item.description: The return of 'The Handmaid's Tale' to VEJA's bestseller lists reflects concerns about the rise of the far right and threats to democracy, with parallels drawn between fiction and recent political episodes involving allies of Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Assista a vídeos em que Lula dizia ser contra reduzir maioridade penal
item.description: Lula previously supported maintaining the age of criminal responsibility at 18, criticizing proposals to reduce it. On October 15, 2026, during a live interview on Globo, he expressed support for lowering the age of criminal responsibility to 16 in cases of heinous crimes. This shift in stance sparked controversy and is linked to the Public Security Amendment Bill (PEC).

item.title: Pesquisa Lula e Flávio no segundo turno: veja quem está na frente nos levantamentos mais recentes
item.description: Recent polls show Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading the runoff against Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), with 47% of voting intentions versus 44.8%. The Lula administration holds 46.8% approval among aggregated voters. The Rali tool, developed by GLOBO and Instituto Locomotiva, consolidates data from institutes like Datafolha, Quaest, and Ipespe to track voting trends and government evaluations.

item.title: Damares pede a líderes religiosos que “não deixem o povo ser enganado”
item.description: Senator Damares Alves asked religious leaders to combat misinformation about Flávio Bolsonaro's proposals for Social Security and social programs, warning that elderly and vulnerable people may be misled.

item.title: Senador do PL promete dinheiro de emendas a cidades com mais votos em Flávio: especialistas veem indício de crime eleitoral
item.description: Senator Reinaldo Azambuja (PL) promised to allocate parliamentary amendments to reward municipalities with more votes for Flávio Bolsonaro, a move viewed by experts as an electoral crime and abuse of power. He coordinated the action with senators Tereza Cristina (PP) and Capitão Contar (PL), suggesting a vote-conditioned reward strategy.

item.title: Composição da Câmara dos Deputados, o que mudou de 2022 para 2026?
item.description: In 2026, the Chamber of Deputies remains led by the PL, which gains 23 more seats, while the PT increases by just one. Female participation rises, but minority representation falls, maintaining a majority of white men with higher education.

item.title: Em aceno a Cleitinho, Lula diz que reconstruirá Minas Gerais
item.description: Lula claimed he is the only chance for Cleitinho Azevedo to recover Minas Gerais, suggesting projects will stall if he doesn't win the election. Cleitinho, elected by Republicans, supported Flávio Roscoe in the second round, while Lula seeks to boost his candidacy with criticism of former governor Romeu Zema.

item.title: Câmara vai implementar fim da 6x1 na semana que vem, diz Motta
item.description: The President of the Chamber of Deputies, Hugo Motta, announced that the House will implement the end of the 6x1 work schedule next week, following the enactment of the constitutional amendment reducing the workweek from 44 to 40 hours over 14 months. The measure benefits approximately 1,700 civil servants with gradual hour reductions and two paid days off, without salary impact.

item.title: Janones convoca "panelaço" durante sabatina de Flávio Bolsonaro na Globo
item.description: André Janones called for supporters to stage a 'pot-banging' protest during Jair Bolsonaro's interview on TV Globo, sharing a video on social media to encourage the demonstration. The action takes place during the campaign for the presidential runoff election on October 25, where Bolsonaro will face Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

item.title: Após polêmica com apoiadores de Lula e Flávio, TSE define critérios para vincular canais de WhatsApp a campanhas
item.description: The TSE approved a resolution establishing criteria to link WhatsApp channels and online forums to electoral campaigns, requiring identified channels to be registered with the Electoral Justice and potentially suspended for spreading prohibited content. The measure follows controversies involving channels linked to supporters of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Campanha de Lula se irrita com almoço de Flávio na Globo
item.description: Lula's allies expressed discomfort over an alleged unequal media treatment after Flávio Bolsonaro met with TV Globo executives. The network stated that the meeting was held privately by João Roberto Marinho and Paulo Tonet, with no journalists involved. The incident occurs amid the 2026 election context, further escalating tensions between the candidates.

item.title: Crusoé: Ônibus de graça de Lula é inconstitucional e inviável
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva announced he will submit a Constitutional Amendment Proposal (PEC) to establish free buses on weekends. The initiative was criticized by Crusoé, a column from Folha de S.Paulo, which deemed it unconstitutional and politically unfeasible. The announcement was made through a video on Lula’s social media.

item.title: Janones celebra volta do ‘Exército do Lula’: “Está praticamente reeleito”
item.description: André Janones celebrated the reactivation of the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel after a TSE dispute, claiming he taught the left to handle digital algorithms. He stated that Lula is practically reelected with the channel's support.

item.title: Leia e assista ao discurso de Alcolumbre na promulgação do fim da 6 X 1
item.description: Davi Alcolumbre presided over a solemn session formalizing amendments that end the 6 X 1 shift schedule and secure special pensions for community health agents and vector control workers, underscoring the political courage required to tackle a controversial issue. The legislative process faced criticism from FIESP and opposition lawmakers, who warned of increased labor informality and rising employer costs. Alcolumbre emphasized state recognition of the beneficiaries, affirming the significance of their service.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro tinha razão sobre Ciro Gomes?
item.description: The alliance between Ciro Gomes (PSDB) and PL in Ceará, which led to Roberto Cláudio (União Brasil) supporting Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), reignited the conflict involving Michelle Bolsonaro and parts of the Bolsonaro family. Michelle had previously criticized Ciro Gomes, though he remains neutral in the 2026 presidential race.

item.title: Artigo: do salto alto nas campanhas ao fim da escala 6x1, como eleitores indecisos veem movimentos do 2º turno
item.description: The 2026 Brazilian elections' second round is marked by uncertainty and polarization, with undecided voters struggling to choose between candidates, particularly amid controversial proposals such as the 6x1 scale. The campaign reveals tensions between the desire for change and the reaction of conservative sectors, affecting electoral dynamics and the emotional wear on voters.

item.title: Meta nega interferência política nas eleições do Brasil e cita 'incidentes técnicos' em redes de Lula
item.description: Meta stated it does not engage in political interference in the Brazilian elections, attributing suspensions and technical errors to flaws in its protection and AI classification systems. The TSE ordered Meta not to block political content from Lula or Flávio Bolsonaro under penalty of daily fines. Lula's campaign accuses Meta of repeated failures in delivering posts.

item.title: Paes entra de cabeça na campanha de Lula e fará evento com lideranças comunitárias atrás de votos para o petista
item.description: Following his defeat in the Rio de Janeiro state election, former mayor Eduardo Paes has decided to actively support Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's re-election campaign, scheduling an event with community leaders in the saquarema. Previously, Paes maintained a strategic distance from Lula, avoiding public appearances and direct mentions in the media, a stance that did not prevent the victory of Douglas Ruas, an ally of Flávio Dóuglas.

item.title: Campanha de Lula reforçará que comparecimento no 2º turno serve como prova de vida do INSS
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's reelection campaign intends to emphasize that voting in the second round serves as proof of life for retired and pensioner citizens, encouraging elderly participation. This strategy was previously referenced during the first round of elections.

item.title: TSE define critérios para vincular canais de WhatsApp às campanhas eleitorais
item.description: The TSE unanimously approved new rules to link WhatsApp channels to electoral campaigns, resolving a dispute involving the 'Exército do Lula' channel. The change aims to regulate the use of instant messaging in campaigns by establishing clear operational criteria.

item.title: A previsão de um líder do centrão ao STF sobre chance de virada de Lula sobre Flávio
item.description: A centrist leader commented on potential shifts in the second round, assessing the likelihood of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva overtaking Flávio Bolsonaro in voter intentions. The analysis was made in conversations with Supreme Federal Court justices and presents projections on electoral dynamics for 2026. The article is exclusive to subscribers, with restricted access to the full content.

item.title: Sem citar Flávio, ex-ministros e ambientalistas criticam 'retomada de propostas' para 'enfraquecer órgãos' fiscalizadores
item.description: Former environment ministers and environmentalists criticize proposals to eliminate overlaps between environmental agencies, viewing Flávio Bolsonaro's plan as a threat to ICMBio and conservation units. The manifesto calls for strengthening these institutions to protect forests and indigenous rights. Concern also extends to Congress, where initiatives to reduce environmental protection are advancing.

item.title: Lula acena a empresários: “Ninguém vai ter prejuízo com fim da 6 X 1”
item.description: Lula stated that the end of the 6 X 1 work schedule will not harm the business sector and emphasized benefits for workers. He criticized the Bolsonaro family and warned that Flávio Bolsonaro's victory could bring back the 6 X 1 schedule. The National Congress enacted the PEC reducing the weekly work hours from 44 to 40, with two paid rest days.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro almoça com presidente e vice de RI da Globo horas antes de sabatina eleitoral
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) had lunch with Globo leadership hours before his electoral interview at the broadcaster. The meeting took place with Grupo Globo president João Roberto Marinho and vice-president of Institutional Relations Paulo Tonet. Flávio was interviewed by Renata Lo Prete at 9:15 PM after the nightly news.

item.title: Criptomoeda pró-Flávio cai 86% após ações do TSE, e donos anunciam fim uma semana após lançamento
item.description: The B22 cryptocurrency, linked to support for Flávio Bolsonaro, dropped 86% a week after launch, prompting creators to shut down operations. They posted an apology video admitting they used politics for visibility.

item.title: Lula manda recado a Cleitinho: “Só tem que ficar quietinho”
item.description: Lula stated that reelection is the only chance for Cleitinho Azevedo to recover Minas Gerais, criticizing the previous Zema administration. He warned that Flávio Bolsonaro's victory would leave the state paralyzed. Lula praised Cleitinho's intelligence and encouraged him to maintain a more conciliatory stance.

item.title: Moraes autoriza Bolsonaro a receber dez convidados para aniversário de 16 anos da filha
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes authorized former President Jair Bolsonaro to receive ten guests for his youngest daughter Laura's 16th birthday at his home in Brasília. The authorization, granted after a request from the defense, allows guests to remain only during the lunch, conditioned on security rules. Among the guests are family members of Michelle Bolsonaro and a BBQ chef.

item.title: Mais de 100 organizações acusam big techs de interferir nas eleições brasileiras
item.description: Over 100 organizations and experts from 25 countries released an open letter accusing major technology companies of violating Brazilian electoral rules, urging authorities to investigate alleged interference in the 2026 elections. The document highlights concerns about the role of big tech in electoral integrity and digital content regulation. The initiative brings together civil and academic sectors internationally, reflecting growing tensions between governments, digital platforms, and representative democracies.

item.title: Maioridade penal: qual a diferença das emendas defendidas por Lula e Flávio
item.description: Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) advocate for lowering the age of criminal responsibility, but propose different age thresholds and categorize distinct crimes. While Lula emphasizes rehabilitation and serious offenses, Flávio prioritizes punishment for specific infractions.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula participa de ato em Juiz de Fora (MG)
item.description: President Lula participates in a campaign event in Juiz de Fora, MG, as part of the mobilization for the 2026 presidential runoff election, where he will face Flávio Bolsonaro. The visit takes place in the contested Zona da Mata region of Minas Gerais.

item.title: Sem definição sobre maioridade, governo avalia votar PEC na próxima semana
item.description: The federal government is considering voting on the Public Security Amendment Bill (PEC) next week, before the election runoff. The matter was removed from the agenda due to disagreements over reducing the age of criminal responsibility. Senator Camilo Santana proposed an amendment limiting the reduction to 16 years only for heinous crimes, while the opposition suggests 14 years. President Lula expressed support for lowering the age of majority for heinous crimes.

item.title: Canal “Cristãos com Lula” não bate meta e campanha cobra seguidores
item.description: A new Datafolha poll projects a tight runoff race between Flávio Bolsonaro (47%) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (45%), with a technical tie when only valid votes are counted. Meanwhile, the WhatsApp channel 'Cristãos com Lula 13', launched with participation from Geraldo Alckmin and Jorge Messias, failed to meet the campaign's expected engagement targets. The electoral scenario remains volatile, with small margins of error that could shift the lead.

item.title: Áudio: Iniciativa do Senado, dia de luto pelo feminicídio convida à conscientização
item.description: Law 15.334, enacted in January 2026, established October 17 as the National Day of Mourning and Memory for Women Victims of Femicide, marking the first official date in Brazil dedicated to this cause. The initiative was led by Senator Leila Barros (PDT-DF), who is currently on leave.

item.title: Fim da 6×1 aprovado: os riscos de uma transição em só 60 dias
item.description: The Senate approved the constitutional amendment ending the 6×1 work schedule and reducing the weekly work hours from 44 to 40, with 75 votes in favor. Vanderlan Cardoso criticized the electoral use of the issue, Mourão voted against, while Erika Hilton and Lula celebrated the approval.

item.title: Moraes autoriza Bolsonaro a receber 10 convidados para aniversário da filha
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes authorized former President Jair Bolsonaro to host 10 guests for a birthday lunch celebrating his daughter Laura's birthday, while serving a home detention sentence. The decision responds to a request from Bolsonaro's defense team, who is under investigation in the context of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Edinho comenta empate de votos do PoderData e diz que Lula “já virou”
item.description: Edinho Silva claimed that Lula has already turned around the presidential race following a new PoderData/Aya poll showing a tie between the former president and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, each with 50% of valid votes. The PT campaign has benefited from the approval of the end of the 6 x 1 workweek and proposals such as free public transportation on weekends.

item.title: Janones dá "missão mais importante" no canal de Lula: "Retomar símbolos"
item.description: André Janones urged supporters of the 'Exército do Lula' to post photos on Saturday (10/17) wearing green and yellow colors and forming the letter 'L' to show support for Lula while challenging the far-right's association with national symbols. The strategy aims to attract undecided voters and weaken the far-right's political identity.

item.title: Perto de voltar a Interlagos, Hamilton diz que se sente em casa no Brasil
item.description: Lewis Hamilton expressed his emotional connection with Brazil, highlighting his status as an honorary citizen since 2022 and his admiration for Brazilian culture and people, particularly tied to the memory of Ayrton Senna. The Ferrari driver shared these sentiments in an official video ahead of the São Paulo Grand Prix, reinforcing his feeling of belonging in the country.

item.title: Flávio e oposição não vão a promulgação do fim da 6 X 1
item.description: Opposition senators, including Flávio Bolsonaro, were absent from the promulgation of the PEC that abolishes the 6 X 1 work schedule, approved by the Senate with 75 votes in favor and 1 against. The measure, which reduces the workday and increases the day off, is a victory for Lula's campaign, who seeks re-election on October 25th. Flávio voted remotely during the solemn session where Lula gave his speech.

item.title: TSE nega pedido de Flávio para restringir apoio de sindicatos e UNE a Lula
item.description: The TSE rejected Flávio Bolsonaro's request to restrict union and UNE support for Lula, ruling that political support cannot be classified as irregular campaign advertising. Minister Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva ordered an investigation into Lula, Alckmin, and union leaders over alleged abuse of power.

item.title: Pesquisas eleitorais mostram a disputa entre Flávio x Lula no segundo turno: veja datas das próximas
item.description: Ten electoral polls will be released between October 17 and 21, ahead of the runoff between Lula and Flávio on October 25. The latest polls show a technical tie between the candidates with minor fluctuations within the margin of error.

item.title: Com sabatina de Lula, Globo tem a maior audiência do dia
item.description: President Lula's interview on TV Globo this Thursday (15) reached 25 points in São Paulo and 28 in Rio de Janeiro, marking the highest ratings of the day in both cities. The interview, conducted by Renata Lo Prete, aired at 9 PM, followed by 'Quem ama cuida,' which scored 24 points in São Paulo. On Friday (16), it will be Flávio Bolsonaro's turn to participate in the same format.

item.title: Alcolumbre negocia idade mínima para indicação ao STF se Flávio Bolsonaro for eleito
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre is negotiating the adoption of a minimum age of 55 or 60 for Supreme Court nominations in the event of Flávio Bolsonaro's election, aiming to reduce right-wing influence on the court.

item.title: Emenda do fim da 6x1 é publicada no Diário Oficial. Prazos começam a valer
item.description: The constitutional amendment ending the 6x1 work schedule was published in the Official Gazette, starting a two-month deadline for companies to implement two weekly rest days and reduce the workweek from 44 to 42 hours. This measure, one of Lula's campaign pledges, marks the first labor reform since 1988.

item.title: Justiça barra entrega de título de cidadão a Flávio após abaixo-assinado
item.description: The Bahia court suspended the ceremony awarding the Citizen Title to Flávio Bolsonaro in Salvador following a public lawsuit and a petition with nearly 200,000 signatures. The judge deemed the event politically partisan and questioned public spending on relocating the City Hall to Farol da Barra during the runoff campaign.

item.title: A decisão de Alexandre de Moraes sobre a festa de aniversário da filha de Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes authorized former President Jair Bolsonaro to hold a 16th birthday barbecue for his daughter at his residence in Brasília, allowing nine guests and a professional BBQ chef, conditioned on compliance with security protocols. The restriction on receiving visitors had been imposed by Moraes due to Bolsonaro's conviction for antidemocratic crimes.

item.title: Flávio quer desconfigurar debate sobre segurança, diz Edinho Silva
item.description: PT president Edinho Silva criticized the PL and Flávio Bolsonaro for attempting to shift the debate on the Public Security PEC to the reduction of the age of criminal responsibility. The PEC, enacted after abolishing the 6x1 schedule, does not include the reduction, which will be addressed separately under a Senate agreement.

item.title: "Futrica" e "bobagem", define Lula sobre desentendimentos com Alcolumbre
item.description: Lula downplayed his disagreements with Alcolumbre, calling them 'nonsense' and emphasizing the need to govern after elections. The reconciliation led to the enactment of the constitutional amendment ending the 6x1 work schedule.

item.title: As mudanças de posição de Lula e Flávio após pesquisas na reta final do segundo turno da eleição
item.description: Lula and Flávio adjust their positions in the final stretch of the election, with Lula supporting the reduction of the criminal responsibility age for serious crimes and Flávio backing the end of the 6×1 work schedule, responding to voter pressure and poll results showing a tight race.
